units.note: Raft-tie sentence (pros hautas men biaios dedemenas, pros de tas allas euthiakopous) read as outermost rafts firmly bound, loosely tied to the rest; English consistent with this.
Bracketed [kai tas kakopatheias] is an editorial deletion, preserved in brackets in English.
Numbers checked: 38,000 foot, 8,000+ horse, three days.
Consul identities (Publius to Iberia, Tiberius at Lilybaeum) consistent.
